insights.one_liner: Venlo-based high-tech printer maker owned by Canon; engineering internships in English with pay shown, and an IND sponsor.

culture.text: All 7 jobs are in Venlo, 6 of them engineering internships.
Staff come mainly from TU Eindhoven, Fontys, Zuyd, Twente and TU Munich, studying mechanical, electrical engineering and computer science.
Offers jobs, internships and graduate projects, and runs a Lean Academy to share know-how.

open.text: Canon Production Printing Netherlands B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
None of its 7 jobs here require Dutch and 71% show pay, though none mention visa support.
Jobs draw about 180 applicants each on LinkedIn on average.

growth.text: Had about 3,300 employees across three continents at the end of 2022, headquartered in Venlo.
Part of Canon, which calls commercial printing one of four businesses underpinning its future.

worth_knowing.text: Won two 2026 PRINTING United Alliance Pinnacle Awards for innovation.
